tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /drug cu sngags bon bca' yig drang thig dge legs kyi 'od snang bzhugs so// swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /dus mthar bsam bzhin byon pa'i bka' drin can/ /dus gcig min par 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum kun gzigs sngags 'chang chen por 'dud/ /'dir drug cu mthil pa sngags bon rnams la bslab bya byed rgyur/ dus phyis rang re'i gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid kyi chos grwa lho byang gi dge 'dun rnams nas mdzad rgyu'i sgrig lam kun spyod la skyon sel cung zad zhu dgos rnams nged rang nas zhib cha 'khod pa'i bca' yig so sor bcos pas/ de dang chabs cig khyed rnams kyang mang ja dang / 'chams sku'i zhabs phyi sogs dge 'dun dang rjes 'brangs du kha shas 'du dgos 'dug pa rnams la/ sngar nas bzung mig ltos ngan pa nyag rkyang gi mgo mjug med pa zhig 'dug par brten/ dus phyis gzhung zhabs par mchog nas mang ja'i dpyad khral yang zur tshogs phud pa'i zhes dmigs bsal bkod snang 'di la dpags na slar khyed rang tsho mang ja'i rigs rtsa chag byung dogs 'dug pa dang / lhag par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ni drug cu mthil pa dang sngags bon la bka' drin shin tu che ba yin kyang / mgon de'i gsung pa'i lha khang chen mo'i bca' yig las/ sngags bon btsun ma rnams kyang rang rang gi chas gos lugs mthun yod cing / lo bco lnga lon pa yan dge 'dun dang ma 'dres par 'khyams smad du thong / mi skya gzhung ma'i chas dang / skya bo'i chos zon pa 'bar zhwa gyon pa rnams mi gtong / zhes gsung pa 'dis sngags bon btsun ma rnams kyi cha lugs gsal zhing / yang bca' yig de nyid las gdan sa dan khrod nas 'byon pa rnams kyi cha lugs sngags dgon gyi bca' yig nang bzhin byed ces gsungs pa 'dis/ gtso bor bde chen gling pa dang / zhar la ser khyim pa drug cu mthil pa rnams kyi bca' yig zur tsam gsung 'dug pas na/

da yang tig nged rang gi cha nas bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal zhing / chos grwa lho byang gi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba dang / sde mi ser byams skyong shin tu che bar byas pa'i/ sa skya pa'i mnga' zhabs tshang ma phyug po dpal 'byor can kho na'i ngos/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde thob pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam khor yug tu yod kyang / lugs gnyis kyi khrims 'di sra thang ma byung ba 'dis/ gegs chags lta bu'i nged rang gi nu bo de chung ngu nas tshe'i dus byas gdung brgyud kyang chad la nye lo phyugs lam du mi rgyug mnga' 'bangs rnams dbul zhing phongs pa sogs/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs zhig yong 'dug pa nas/ slan chad nged rang tshe mthar phyin cing / gdung brgyud chad med 'byung ba dang / chab 'bangs rnams la lo phyugs legs pa sogs bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ sngar srol bzang po bzhin byed dgos tshul chos grwa lho byang gi bca' yig dang / phyag gnyer gyis mtshon drung 'khor ser skya 'bul sdud tshong khag gzhis gnyer sogs tshang mar kha ta'i yi ge bcas yod pa dang cha 'dra bar khyed rang drug cu mthil pa rnams kyang da nas bzung / skra bregs/ mang ja sogs dge 'dun dang cha 'dra byed dgos rnams la gos dmar/ zan dmar/ bod lh+wam bcas gyon/ lo co lnga yan chad mang ja yong rgyu dang / sngags bon rnams kyang rang rang gi cha lugs 'gal med bod lh+wam gyon pa bcas dang / lo grangs drug cu mthil pa dang cha 'dra yong ba la gtong babs chol ya ma bzung gtan nas mi byed/ 'don cha'i rim pa/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma/ tshad med bzhi/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs shlau ka gcig ja mchod skal bzang ma dang / ngo mtshar ma/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku bstod shes bya kun la ma yongs rdzogs/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi sku bstod ngag dbang lha yi mkhyen brtse ma/ rgyal ba gnyis pa nas ring 'tsho'i bden tshig gi bar deng sang bzhin/

bsam pa myur 'grub ma/ ltung bshags/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma le tshan/ bdag gi dus gsum ma/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes sogs/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ gangs can bod kyi sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs/ mang ja yong mi gang yod de'i bzung nas/ sngar gyi rgan bu rnams phud nged rang dang lo mnyam man chad nas bzung slar mang ja rgyug dgos tshang mas/ dpon slob brgya tsho dpon la rgyugs 'bul bya ngos/ khyed rang tsho'i khrod nas dbu byed gang 'os zhig gis bskul nas mang ja mang ba'i skabs phral rgyu dang las dus med cing nyung skabs sde tshan gcig la tshang ma gtong rgyu dang / las dus thug skabs sna kha re gnyis gtang nas grol ba ma gtogs/ rnam pa kun tu bag med byas pa byung na/ mang ja'i skabs gtso bor lha khang chos khrims pa dang / sger du chu skor zam sne ba sogs khyed rang tsho'i 'go yod rnams nas kha ta sogs 'jur gang dam byed dgos par lha khang chos khrims par yang de'i rgyu mtshan song bas de bzhin dang yang drug cu mthil pa nas dmigs bsal byed dgos/ dgu gnam gang gi dus gtor dang / phag snying dbyar rim la mang ja spor do dang / sdod gnyer khang nas do skor/ dus gtor gyi chas ka lcags ya re dang / sha 'os 'tshams las zhing snga thog bzhin/ dbyar mthong lo gsar gyi rten dang / thug rgyu nas khal phyed gnyis re zhu ba'i/ yang na da ltar bzhin spyi mchod pas nyos nas zhing rin ṭaṃ bcu re drug cu mthil pa spyir sprad byed rgyu gnyis byings la slebs gang che las mtshan gyis do dam byas ngos de dag gi skabs su bskang ba sogs mi thon pas chos spyod gang 'grub re gtong / sa 'dul gyis 'chams pa rnams rin chen sdings par gtugs pa'i shes na dang mi shes pa rnams nas 'don sngar srol bzhin/ dbyar rim phag snying skabs/ stong ja/ gyer ja/ bsdus chang byas nas slebs rkyang yod tshe sngar srol bzhin dang /

chos khrims pa chu zam gnyis dang bcu dpon rdza ma ba dang gtso thabs pa gnyis la phyed 'dren chen po dang / stong dpon don bkras dang rgyab hral ma gnyis la bzhi cha yong ba'i rgyu mtshan drug cu pa'i sgrig lam tshang mar 'go sdom byed dgos kyi gsol ras yin par nges shing / dus mdos sogs kyi skabs 'chams sku'i zhabs phyi dang dung sbugs khag gang dgos/ gtso thab pa'i nag reng pa/ btang bla'i rnga zlum thob zhwa/ gru lhag dge slong gi gzhugs/ phur sgrub ho hang gi gras/ dus mdos zab mo'i skabs bud med kyi 'chams sogs tshang ma khral 'jal stong min tsam du ma song bar thag pa khur blang rang gzhan ngo mi tsha ba zhig byed dgos rgyu dang / mdzod pa'i skor las byed khung la/ dus chen dgongs rdzogs gang yod rigs la phyag mdzod dang gnyer tshang du brda gtong dang / tshogs byings dang 'dren chen mor thud ltar 'gyed dgos/ las chen dbu chos/ las thog spyi chen rnams kyi zur sprod dang / spyi 'gyed zhu dgos cho ga dus ma dang / rags kha chog chen sogs la yang 'gyed dgos gong mtshungs dang / rags kha chog chen yod pa'i sngon nyin mar thud bzhugs gral 'byed dgos dang / ban tshang dbu mchod/ dkar rgyang pa/ bde gling dbu chos/ chos grwa lho'i dbu chos/ spyi las/ lho mchod dpon bla brang drung chen/ mthil sku gnyen/ chos sde lho byang gi sgo rwa ba dang gzhi thog sgo rwa ba/ drug cu bcu dpon gnyis/ drug cu chos khrims gnyis mdzod g.yog bcas la/ sbyin bdag pa nas len sprod dang / 'bum ther gang yod la tshogs brda dang / sko 'gyed spyi 'gyed las thog pa dang gnyis sang gi byed dgos/ thud bskyed khung gong mtshungs/ mus chen dang mchod 'bul la/ bla rigs la brda gtong dang / phyed 'dren bskyed khungs dbyangs dpon bcu bzhi/ zor las pa lnga/ dkang rgyang pa mdzod g.yog bzhi cha bskyed khungs rin sgang btsun ma dbu byed gsum/

spyi pa bzhi/ sngags bon chos sgo gnyis/ drug cu stong dpon gnyis/ chos khrims gzhon pa/ sgo rwa ba gsum/ ja tsha gnyis/ spyi pa bzhi rnams la bskyed dgos/ cho ga'i rigs la rim lnga dar dpyangs yod med las thog pa dang mdzod g.yog gnyis kyis bskor nas me rigs kyi mar thud bsdus nas 'byam tshul la 'bul/ gza' 'dzin byung dus gnyer tshang du 'gyed brda nas 'gyed yod rigs la gtong gong mtshungs/ spe ser 'ong phud skabs/ brgya las gsum la brda gtong dang zur sprod zhu dgos/ spyi pa'i lo gsar/ dbyar mthong sogs kyi btub/ rtsa lud kyi rgyab 'gro/ lo gsar gyi khyed 'dren bskyed khungs gong mtshungs/ sa bir gyi sa rtsi gtong dgos dang / skas 'dzugs/ bsangs gtong / bzhi len gcig bskyugs gyi brda/ las chen pa zur sprod/ spyi 'gyed zhu ba sogs gong mtshungs/ gcig bskur bu ram deb nang ltar zhu dgos/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod bu ram zhu khungs gong mtshungs/ mdos chen nyer brgyad la tho bsgrigs bzhugs gral las tshan brda gtong / nyer dgu la las tshan skong chog gong mtshungs/ zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la bkra shis lha khang gi rnam rgyal gyi gur zhu ba shing dang chas len/ brda gtong / dge tsha'i rab gnas skabs/ gur zhu dgos dang 'bul mi grong rab bzhis 'bul dgos/ skyed lhas nang so gnyis kyi mdzod pa gtor spod kyi dgos cha deb nang ltar zhu dgos/ phag snying dbyar rim gyi zhu dgos kyang gong mtshungs/ sdud khral dang 'gyed dkor skul sogs kyang btsun chung dpe 'dra dang / zhar byung rug dmar sogs grwa tshang dang 'brel ba tshang mar yang gang la gang dgos de dang de 'chug med du bgyid cing / sngags bon rnams nas dmigs bsal byed dgos/ dus mdos/ sku rim chen mo/ phag snying / lha mo gsol mchod skabs sogs/ sngags bon gyi 'don pa gtong khungs tshang ma las slar ma song ba'i sbyong brdar dang / de dag gi skabs kyi mdos dang 'chams rnga rol chas gos sogs tshang ma khyed rang tsho'i gzhung bzhin 'gad gtsang ma gtong byis pa'i rtse mo lta bu'i chal chol du ma song ba zhig dga' che zhing /

dar chen so sor sprod len dang nged rang klung rta 'dzugs rgyu/ skyed lhas byas 'gyur gyi gzim phug bzhi dang / 'jam chu'i sa rtsi/ phur sgrub gtor 'bul/ mgon po mnga' gsol/ mdos sde/ nged rang phyogs 'grul 'gugs dus/ gzhi thog phun tshogs gling / lha khang rtse rnams su dar 'dzin sogs khral gang 'babs la'ang las sla dang 'khur med du ma song ba'i hur bskyed sogs/ gdan sa'i zhabs phyi zhu dgos tshang ma/ phyag gnyer las tshan rim can gyi bkod khyab bzhin byed dgos pas/ gang ltar da lam gyi yi ge 'di khyed rnams la snying rje med par dbang yod kyi tshig kha dal lta bu ma yin par khyed rang tsho'i 'di phyi'i don dang / bstan don la rgya la bsams nas bris pa yin pas/ 'di'i do dam pa bka' bgros pa'i gtso bor brgya tsho dpon la mdzad dgos pa bzhin/ grangs can gdan sa pa rim can dang / chu skor zam sne ba sogs rang rang gi 'og yod tshang mas do dam dang / de las gzhan rnams kyis dang 'dod lhur blang gal che zhing / las tshan rnams kyis lugs mthun ma byas pa dang / lugs mthun byas kyang gzhan gyis ma nyan pa sogs byung na gzhung du gsal slebs par gyi/ bden rdzun dbye 'byed ngos phyis lam khegs pa'i bkod khyab tshang ma de thog nas byed pa yin pas tshang mas go 'tshal zhes legs nyes gsal ba'i yi ge drang thig dge legs kyi 'od snang 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ drug cu sngags bon bca' yig drang thig dge legs kyi 'od snang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
